summary: ansible-galaxy role delete github_user github_repo removes a role from Galaxy only, needs an API token, and requires access to the GitHub repo.
questions: How do I remove my role from Galaxy?
Does deleting a role on Galaxy delete my GitHub repo?

answer_card.title: Delete a role from Galaxy
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role delete github_user github_repo
```
Needs your API token (`ansible.cfg` or `--token`) and access to the GitHub repo. It only removes the role from Galaxy; the GitHub repository is untouched.
